request: Design an embedded-payments strategy for a vertical SaaS company.
selection_rationale: Embedded platform strategy needs platform/merchant/sponsor responsibilities and funds-flow design, including explicit PayFac/MoR distinctions. Existing acceptance, regulatory, architecture and economics packages provide bounded inputs, not the complete platform proposition.
practitioner_judgment: Correct platform-flow capability gap. Existing commercial, regulatory, economics and architecture packages may contribute bounded artifacts without completing embedded-platform strategy.
